items.title: Luis Conte interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 24, 2025
items.q: he got a call to play with a Mick Jagger recording

ctx.x: I was able to speak with him and he had this story that he got a call to play with a Mick Jagger recording and he said, “I brought every piece of percussion I could get my hands on: littlest shakers, big drums, small drums, tambourines, a whole van load. I wanted to be ready. Turns out all they wanted me to do was play fills on a syn drum. You know? Boom. So I sat there for six hours going boom.”

Yup. Well I wanted to do a Madonna recording and I sent everything I thought, because it was for the movie Dick Tracy. I sent everything I own. And I ended up playing triangle. It was triangle on this one song [scats]. “Okay great, we got it, thanks Luis,” “Okay, see ya.” So you never know.
